questions.ask: Does a deploy start when something POSTs to a deploy webhook URL?
questions.why: Installs scripts/deploy/trigger-deploy.sh, which treats a 3xx as a refusal (a bare curl reports it as success) and keeps the secret URL out of its output and the process list. Claude must ask you before each run.
questions.detect: a workflow or script reads DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_URL, or .github/scripts/trigger-deploy.sh exists
